children: According to Wallstreetcn, Russian President Vladimir Putin met with U.S. President Donald Trump's envoy Steve Witkoff and son-in-law Jared Kushner at the Kremlin for more than three hours on the evening of December 5, and the talks were described as substantive, constructive, extremely frank, and based on mutual trust.

title: Putin Meets Witkoff and Kushner for More Than 3 Hours, Ushakov Says
